description: This file implements subtitle processing functions including quality checks, normalization, generation, translation, and validation for subtitle files, primarily handling SRT format. It integrates with external utilities for time formatting and subtitle correction, and contains functions for manipulating subtitle texts, enforcing constraints, and simulating subtitle generation and translation.

methods.name: str run_quality_check_and_correct( subtitle_path: str, video_path: Optional[str], language: Optional[str], enforce_ott: bool, processed_dir: str, )
methods.description: Performs basic validation and normalization on the subtitle file, enforcing whitespace normalization and caption line limits if specified. Returns the path to the corrected subtitle file.

methods.name: str generate_subtitles_for_video( video_path: str, language: Optional[str], processed_dir: str, model_hint: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Creates a placeholder SRT subtitle file for a given video, simulating output from an STT engine with fixed content.

methods.name: str translate_subtitles( subtitle_path: str, target_language: str, source_language: Optional[str], processed_dir: str, model_hint: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Simulates subtitle translation by appending language code to each text line, preserving the SRT structure.

methods.name: List[str] validate_subtitles(subtitle_path: str, options: Dict)
methods.description: Checks a subtitle file for common issues such as line length, number of lines per caption, and presence of text, reporting any violations.
